The rating for the content.

Usage guidelines:

* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

reviewCount.label: Review Count

Answer.label: Answer
Answer.description: An answer offered to a question; perhaps correct, perhaps opinionated or wrong.

text.label: Text
text.description: The textual content of this CreativeWork.

Article.label: Article
Article.description: An article, such as a news article or piece of investigative report. Newspapers and magazines have articles of many different types and this is intended to cover them all.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

image.label: Image
image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

datePublished.label: Date Published
datePublished.description: Date of first publication or broadcast. For example the date a [[CreativeWork]] was broadcast or a [[Certification]] was issued.

dateModified.label: Date Modified
dateModified.description: The date on which the CreativeWork was most recently modified or when the item's entry was modified within a DataFeed.

author.description: The author of this content or rating. Please note that author is special in that HTML 5 provides a special mechanism for indicating authorship via the rel tag. That is equivalent to this and may be used interchangeably.

publisher.label: Publisher
publisher.description: The publisher of the article in question.

ContactPoint.label: ContactPoint
ContactPoint.description: A contact point—for example, a Customer Complaints department.

contactType.label: Contact Type
contactType.description: A person or organization can have different contact points, for different purposes. For example, a sales contact point, a PR contact point and so on. This property is used to specify the kind of contact point.

availableLanguage.label: Available Language
availableLanguage.description: A language someone may use with or at the item, service or place. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[inLanguage]].

Course.label: Course
Course.description: A description of an educational course which may be offered as distinct instances which take place at different times or take place at different locations, or be offered through different media or modes of study. An educational course is a sequence of one or more educational events and/or creative works which aims to build knowledge, competence or ability of learners.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.

courseCode.label: Course Code
courseCode.description: The identifier for the [[Course]] used by the course [[provider]] (e.g. CS101 or 6.001).

offers.label: Offers
offers.description: An offer to provide this item—for example, an offer to sell a product, rent the DVD of a movie, perform a service, or give away tickets to an event. Use [[businessFunction]] to indicate the kind of transaction offered, i.e. sell, lease, etc. This property can also be used to describe a [[Demand]]. While this property is listed as expected on a number of common types, it can be used in others. In that case, using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.

inLanguage.label: In Language
inLanguage.description: The language of the content or performance or used in an action. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[availableLanguage]].

Event.label: Event
Event.description: An event happening at a certain time and location, such as a concert, lecture, or festival. Ticketing information may be added via the [[offers]] property. Repeated events may be structured as separate Event objects.

startDate.label: Start Date
startDate.description: The start date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).

location.label: Location
location.description: The location of, for example, where an event is happening, where an organization is located, or where an action takes place.

endDate.label: End Date
endDate.description: The end date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).

image.label: Image
image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

eventStatus.label: Event Status
eventStatus.description: An eventStatus of an event represents its status; particularly useful when an event is cancelled or rescheduled.

eventAttendanceMode.label: Event Attendance Mode
eventAttendanceMode.description: The eventAttendanceMode of an event indicates whether it occurs online, offline, or a mix.

offers.label: Offers
offers.description: An offer to provide this item—for example, an offer to sell a product, rent the DVD of a movie, perform a service, or give away tickets to an event. Use [[businessFunction]] to indicate the kind of transaction offered, i.e. sell, lease, etc. This property can also be used to describe a [[Demand]]. While this property is listed as expected on a number of common types, it can be used in others. In that case, using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.

performer.label: Performer
performer.description: A performer at the event—for example, a presenter, musician, musical group or actor.

FAQPage.label: FAQPage
FAQPage.description: A [[FAQPage]] is a [[WebPage]] presenting one or more "[Frequently asked questions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FAQ)" (see also [[QAPage]]).

mainEntity.label: Main Entity
mainEntity.description: Indicates the primary entity described in some page or other CreativeWork.

GeoCoordinates.label: GeoCoordinates
GeoCoordinates.description: The geographic coordinates of a place or event.

latitude.label: Latitude
latitude.description: The latitude of a location. For example ```37.42242``` ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)).

longitude.label: Longitude
longitude.description: The longitude of a location. For example ```-122.08585``` ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)).

image.label: Image
image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

openingHours.label: Opening Hours
openingHours.description:
The general opening hours for a business. Opening hours can be specified as a weekly time range, starting with days, then times per day. Multiple days can be listed with commas ',' separating each day. Day or time ranges are specified using a hyphen '-'.

* Days are specified using the following two-letter combinations: ```Mo```, ```Tu```, ```We```, ```Th```, ```Fr```, ```Sa```, ```Su```.
* Times are specified using 24:00 format. For example, 3pm is specified as ```15:00```, 10am as ```10:00```. 
* Here is an example: Tuesdays and Thursdays 4-8pm.
* If a business is open 7 days a week, then it can be specified as Monday through Sunday, all day.

priceRange.label: Price Range
priceRange.description: The price range of the business, for example ```$$$```.

HowTo.label: HowTo
HowTo.description: Instructions that explain how to achieve a result by performing a sequence of steps.

step.label: Step
step.description: A single step item (as HowToStep, text, document, video, etc.) or a HowToSection.

image.label: Image
image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

totalTime.label: Total Time
totalTime.description: The total time required to perform instructions or a direction (including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

supply.label: Supply
supply.description: A sub-property of instrument. A supply consumed when performing instructions or a direction.

tool.label: Tool
tool.description: A sub property of instrument. An object used (but not consumed) when performing instructions or a direction.

HowToStep.label: HowToStep
HowToStep.description: A step in the instructions for how to achieve a result. It is an ordered list with HowToDirection and/or HowToTip items.

text.label: Text
text.description: The textual content of this CreativeWork.

image.label: Image
image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

caption.label: Caption
caption.description: The caption for this object. For downloadable machine formats (closed caption, subtitles etc.) use MediaObject and indicate the [[encodingFormat]].

creator.label: Creator
creator.description: The creator/author of this CreativeWork. This is the same as the Author property for CreativeWork.

license.label: License
license.description: A license document that applies to this content, typically indicated by URL.

JobPosting.label: JobPosting
JobPosting.description: A listing that describes a job opening in a certain organization.

datePosted.label: Date Posted
datePosted.description: Publication date of an online listing.

hiringOrganization.label: Hiring Organization
hiringOrganization.description: Organization or Person offering the job position.

jobLocation.label: Job Location
jobLocation.description: A (typically single) geographic location associated with the job position.

validThrough.label: Valid Through
validThrough.description: The date after when the item is not valid. For example the end of an offer, salary period, or a period of opening hours.

employmentType.label: Employment Type
employmentType.description: Type of employment (e.g. full-time, part-time, contract, temporary, seasonal, internship).

baseSalary.label: Base Salary
baseSalary.description: The base salary of the job or of an employee in an EmployeeRole.

directApply.label: Direct Apply
directApply.description: Indicates whether an [[url]] that is associated with a [[JobPosting]] enables direct application for the job, via the posting website. A job posting is considered to have directApply of [[True]] if an application process for the specified job can be directly initiated via the url(s) given (noting that e.g. multiple internet domains might nevertheless be involved at an implementation level). A value of [[False]] is appropriate if there is no clear path to applying directly online for the specified job, navigating directly from the JobPosting url(s) supplied.

identifier.label: Identifier
identifier.description: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.

LocalBusiness.label: LocalBusiness
LocalBusiness.description: A particular physical business or branch of an organization. Examples of LocalBusiness include a restaurant, a particular branch of a restaurant chain, a branch of a bank, a medical practice, a club, a bowling alley, etc.

image.label: Image
image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

priceRange.description: The price range of the business, for example ```$$$```.

geo.label: Geo
geo.description: The geo coordinates of the place.

aggregateRating.label: Aggregate Rating
aggregateRating.description: The overall rating, based on a collection of reviews or ratings, of the item.

MonetaryAmount.label: MonetaryAmount
MonetaryAmount.description: A monetary value or range. This type can be used to describe an amount of money such as $50 USD, or a range as in describing a bank account being suitable for a balance between £1,000 and £1,000,000 GBP, or the value of a salary, etc. It is recommended to use [[PriceSpecification]] Types to describe the price of an Offer, Invoice, etc.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: The currency in which the monetary amount is expressed.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

value.label: Value
value.description:
The value of a [[QuantitativeValue]] (including [[Observation]]) or property value node.

* For [[QuantitativeValue]] and [[MonetaryAmount]], the recommended type for values is 'Number'.
* For [[PropertyValue]], it can be 'Text', 'Number', 'Boolean', 'StructuredValue' or 'QualitativeValue'.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

Offer.label: Offer
Offer.description:
An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service — for example, an offer to sell tickets to an event, to rent the DVD of a movie, to stream a TV show over the internet, to repair a motorcycle, or to loan a book.

Note: As the [[businessFunction]] property, which identifies the form of offer (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose), defaults to http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell; an Offer without a defined businessFunction value can be assumed to be an offer to sell.

For [GTIN](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin)-related fields, see [Check Digit calculator](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/support/check_digit_calculator) and [validation guide](http://www.gs1us.org/resources/standards/gtin-validation-guide) from [GS1](http://www.gs1.org/).

price.label: Price
price.description:
The offer price of a product, or of a price component when attached to PriceSpecification and its subtypes.

Usage guidelines:

* Use the [[priceCurrency]] property (with standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR") instead of including [ambiguous symbols](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dollar_sign#Currencies_that_use_the_dollar_or_peso_sign) such as '$' in the value.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.
* Note that both [RDFa](http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml-rdfa-primer/#using-the-content-attribute) and Microdata syntax allow the use of a "content=" attribute for publishing simple machine-readable values alongside more human-friendly formatting.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.

priceCurrency.label: Price Currency
priceCurrency.description: The currency of the price, or a price component when attached to [[PriceSpecification]] and its subtypes.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

availability.label: Availability
availability.description: The availability of this item—for example In stock, Out of stock, Pre-order, etc.

priceValidUntil.label: Price Valid Until
priceValidUntil.description: The date after which the price is no longer available.

itemCondition.label: Item Condition
itemCondition.description: A predefined value from OfferItemCondition specifying the condition of the product or service, or the products or services included in the offer. Also used for product return policies to specify the condition of products accepted for returns.

Organization.label: Organization
Organization.description: An organization such as a school, NGO, corporation, club, etc.

sameAs.label: Same As
sameAs.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. E.g. the URL of the item's Wikipedia page, Wikidata entry, or official website.

contactPoint.label: Contact Point
contactPoint.description: A contact point for a person or organization.

Person.label: Person
Person.description: A person (alive, dead, undead, or fictional).

image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

jobTitle.label: Job Title
jobTitle.description: The job title of the person (for example, Financial Manager).

sameAs.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. E.g. the URL of the item's Wikipedia page, Wikidata entry, or official website.

worksFor.label: Works For
worksFor.description: Organizations that the person works for.

Place.label: Place
Place.description: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical extension.

geo.label: Geo
geo.description: The geo coordinates of the place.

image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

streetAddress.label: Street Address
streetAddress.description: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

addressLocality.label: Address Locality
addressLocality.description: The locality in which the street address is, and which is in the region. For example, Mountain View.

addressCountry.label: Address Country
addressCountry.description: The country. Recommended to be in 2-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1) format, for example "US". For backward compatibility, a 3-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3) country code such as "SGP" or a full country name such as "Singapore" can also be used.

addressRegion.label: Address Region
addressRegion.description: The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. For example, California or another appropriate first-level [Administrative division](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_administrative_divisions_by_country) such as the Province in Italy or Region in Germany.

Product.label: Product
Product.description: Any offered product or service. For example: a pair of shoes; a concert ticket; the rental of a car; a haircut; or an episode of a TV show streamed online.

image.label: Image
image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

sku.label: Sku
sku.description: The Stock Keeping Unit (SKU), i.e. a merchant-specific identifier for a product or service, or the product to which the offer refers.

brand.label: Brand
brand.description: The brand(s) associated with a product or service, or the brand(s) maintained by an organization or business person.

offers.label: Offers

Use [[businessFunction]] to indicate the kind of transaction offered, i.e. sell, lease, etc. This property can also be used to describe a [[Demand]]. While this property is listed as expected on a number of common types, it can be used in others. In that case, using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.

aggregateRating.label: Aggregate Rating
aggregateRating.description: The overall rating, based on a collection of reviews or ratings, of the item.

gtin.label: Gtin
gtin.description:
A Global Trade Item Number ([GTIN](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin)). GTINs identify trade items, including products and services, using numeric identification codes.

A correct [[gtin]] value should be a valid GTIN, which means that it should be an all-numeric string of either 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, or a "GS1 Digital Link" URL based on such a string. The numeric component should also have a [valid GS1 check digit](https://www.gs1.org/services/check-digit-calculator) and meet the other rules for valid GTINs. See also [GS1's GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) and [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Global_Trade_Item_Number) for more details. Left-padding of the gtin values is not required or encouraged. The [[gtin]] property generalizes the earlier [[gtin8]], [[gtin12]], [[gtin13]], and [[gtin14]] properties.

The GS1 [digital link specifications](https://www.gs1.org/standards/Digital-Link/) expresses GTINs as URLs (URIs, IRIs, etc.).
Digital Links should be populated into the [[hasGS1DigitalLink]] attribute.

Note also that this is a definition for how to include GTINs in Schema.org data, and not a definition of GTINs in general - see the GS1 documentation for authoritative details.

mpn.label: Mpn
mpn.description: The Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the product, or the product to which the offer refers.

        [[AccountingService]], [[Attorney]], [[Notary]], as well as types for several kinds of [[HomeAndConstructionBusiness]]: [[Electrician]], [[GeneralContractor]],
        [[HousePainter]], [[Locksmith]], [[Plumber]], [[RoofingContractor]]. [[LegalService]] was introduced as a more inclusive supertype of [[Attorney]].

acceptedAnswer.label: Accepted Answer
acceptedAnswer.description: The answer(s) that has been accepted as best, typically on a Question/Answer site. Sites vary in their selection mechanisms, e.g. drawing on community opinion and/or the view of the Question author.

Rating.description: A rating is an evaluation on a numeric scale, such as 1 to 5 stars.

totalTime.label: Total Time

recipeYield.label: Recipe Yield
recipeYield.description: The quantity produced by the recipe (for example, number of people served, number of servings, etc).

recipeIngredient.label: Recipe Ingredient
recipeIngredient.description: An ingredient or ordered list of ingredients and potentially quantities used in the recipe, e.g. 1 cup of sugar, flour or garlic.  The ingredients can be represented as free text or more structured values.

recipeInstructions.label: Recipe Instructions

recipeCategory.label: Recipe Category

recipeCuisine.label: Recipe Cuisine

Review.description: A review of an item - for example, of a restaurant, movie, or store.

itemReviewed.label: Item Reviewed
itemReviewed.description: The item that is being reviewed/rated.

reviewRating.label: Review Rating
reviewRating.description: The rating given in this review. Note that reviews can themselves be rated. The ```reviewRating``` applies to rating given by the review. The [[aggregateRating]] property applies to the review itself, as a creative work.

author.label: Author
author.description: The author of this content or rating. Please note that author is special in that HTML 5 provides a special mechanism for indicating authorship via the rel tag. That is equivalent to this and may be used interchangeably.

reviewBody.label: Review Body
reviewBody.description: The actual body of the review.

datePublished.label: Date Published
datePublished.description: Date of first publication or broadcast. For example the date a [[CreativeWork]] was broadcast or a [[Certification]] was issued.

Service.label: Service
Service.description: A service provided by an organization, e.g. delivery service, print services, etc.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.

areaServed.label: Area Served
areaServed.description: The geographic area where a service or offered item is provided.

offers.label: Offers
offers.description: An offer to provide this item—for example, an offer to sell a product, rent the DVD of a movie, perform a service, or give away tickets to an event. Use [[businessFunction]] to indicate the kind of transaction offered, i.e. sell, lease, etc. This property can also be used to describe a [[Demand]]. While this property is listed as expected on a number of common types, it can be used in others. In that case, using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.

image.label: Image
image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

serviceType.label: Service Type
serviceType.description: The type of service being offered, e.g. veterans' benefits, emergency relief, etc.

offers.label: Offers
offers.description: An offer to provide this item—for example, an offer to sell a product, rent the DVD of a movie, perform a service, or give away tickets to an event. Use [[businessFunction]] to indicate the kind of transaction offered, i.e. sell, lease, etc. This property can also be used to describe a [[Demand]]. While this property is listed as expected on a number of common types, it can be used in others. In that case, using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.

applicationCategory.label: Application Category
applicationCategory.description: Type of software application, e.g. 'Game, Multimedia'.

operatingSystem.label: Operating System
operatingSystem.description: Operating systems supported (Windows 7, OS X 10.6, Android 1.6).

aggregateRating.label: Aggregate Rating
aggregateRating.description: The overall rating, based on a collection of reviews or ratings, of the item.

image.label: Image
image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

openingHours.label: Opening Hours
openingHours.description:
The general opening hours for a business. Opening hours can be specified as a weekly time range, starting with days, then times per day. Multiple days can be listed with commas ',' separating each day. Day or time ranges are specified using a hyphen '-'.

* Days are specified using the following two-letter combinations: ```Mo```, ```Tu```, ```We```, ```Th```, ```Fr```, ```Sa```, ```Su```.
* Times are specified using 24:00 format. For example, 3pm is specified as ```15:00```, 10am as ```10:00```. 
* Here is an example: Tuesdays and Thursdays 4-8pm.
* If a business is open 7 days a week, then it can be specified as Monday through Sunday, all day.

priceRange.label: Price Range
priceRange.description: The price range of the business, for example ```$$$```.

thumbnailUrl.label: Thumbnail Url
thumbnailUrl.description: A thumbnail image relevant to the Thing.

uploadDate.label: Upload Date
uploadDate.description: Date (including time if available) when this media object was uploaded to this site.

contentUrl.label: Content Url
contentUrl.description: Actual bytes of the media object, for example the image file or video file.

embedUrl.label: Embed Url
embedUrl.description: A URL pointing to a player for a specific video. In general, this is the information in the ```src``` element of an ```embed``` tag and should not be the same as the content of the ```loc``` tag.

duration.label: Duration
duration.description: The duration of the item (movie, audio recording, event, etc.) in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

WebPage.label: WebPage
WebPage.description: A web page. Every web page is implicitly assumed to be declared to be of type WebPage, so the various properties about that webpage, such as breadcrumb may be used. We recommend explicit declaration if these properties are specified, but if they are found outside of an itemscope, they will be assumed to be about the page.

image.label: Image
image.description: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

datePublished.label: Date Published
datePublished.description: Date of first publication or broadcast. For example the date a [[CreativeWork]] was broadcast or a [[Certification]] was issued.

dateModified.label: Date Modified
dateModified.description: The date on which the CreativeWork was most recently modified or when the item's entry was modified within a DataFeed.
